item.title: Aki Dropped For 6 Nations Opener
item.description: Bundee Aki has been dropped from the Ireland squad ahead of next week’s Six Nations opener away to France. The Connacht centre is set to face a disciplinary committee following comments made to match officials after Connacht’s loss to Leinster on Saturday. As a result, the IRFU has withdrawn the 35-year-old from the squad and he did not travel with the rest of the panel for their warm-weather training camp in Portugal. item.title: Kerry County Council launched 20 Part V enforcement actions against developers over five years
item.description: Kerry County Council have launched 20 Part V enforcement actions against developers in the past five years. According to the Journal.ie this is the most of any local authority in the country. Part V of the Planning and Development Act, requires a percentage of new housing developments to be allocated for social and affordable housing. item.title: Kerry pharmacist says new service allowing them to prescribe treatments will take pressure off GPs
item.description: A Kerry pharmacist says changes allowing them to prescribe treatments for minor illnesses, will help take the pressure off GPs. The Common Conditions Service allows pharmacists to prescribe treatments for eight minor illnesses. These include shingles, cystitis, cold sores and conjunctivitis. item.title: Atonio Survives Cardiac Arrest And Retires With Immediate Effect
item.description: La Rochelle prop Uini Atonio has been forced to retire from rugby after suffering a heart attack. The 35-year-old France international remains in intensive care but is reported to be in a stable condition. Atonio had initially been named in the French squad to face Ireland in the Six Nations, but withdrew earlier this week. Advertisement

item.title: Chair of Rowing Ireland refuses to apologise to athletes including Kerry rower, over treatment in high performance programme
item.description: The Chair of Rowing Ireland has refused to apologise to athletes, including Kerry’s Monika Dukarska, for what he described as unacceptable experiences in their high performance programme. Barry McWilliams was one of three Rowing Ireland representatives who came before an Oireachtas hearing today, along with representatives from Sport Ireland. The meeting had been called following revelations in the Sunday Independent in November about allegations of mistreatment in the high performance programme

item.title: Calls for bus services at Kerry Airport to be coordinated with plane departures and arrivals
item.description: A Kerry County Councillor is calling for bus services at Kerry Airport to be coordinated with scheduled plane departure and arrival times. Councillor John O'Donoghue made the call at the recent full council meeting. The Kerry Independent Alliance councillor believes the bus service currently does not tie in well with plane departure times.
